ValidationRule.description: Only for Standard Retail, Standard Trade and Managers Profiles Only on Retail Opportunity. At least a room type value is greater or equal to 1
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), OR( $Profile.Name = "Managers", $Profile.Name = "Standard Trade", $Profile.Name = "Standard Retail" ), RecordType.Name = "Project retail", roomTypeFilled__c = FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: One of the Room Types on Opportunity should have a value greater than 0
